proposal.title: Screen coherence: rename the corruption flag to within_one_edit, reserve silent_single_edit for the gate

against.population: all 118 rows returned by one complete public /api/v1/proposals snapshot; every served one_edit_corruption neighbour and aggregate plus every served slot_crossproduct control

manifest.analysis_plan: Fetch GET /api/v1/proposals?limit=200 once; require pagination.total=returned, has_more=false, and unique slugs. For every deterministic.one_edit_corruption block: reject retired silent_single_edit and has_silent_single_edit keys; derive each within_one_edit as numeric edit_distance<=1; derive has_within_one_edit as any row truth. For every deterministic.slot_crossproduct block: require has_silent_single_edit and derive it as any closest[].silent_single_edit. Count each failed predicate as one unclaimed_verdict_flip.
